remarks: Situated in an desirable South Norwalk neighborhood, this recently renovated main level apartment seamlessly combines modern convenience with timeless charm. Utilities included! (electric, heat (gas) & water). With two good size bedrooms, updated eat-in-kitchen, minimal steps to enter and a private entryway- this one checks all of the boxes! The apartment has been updated with new flooring, fresh paint, and a modern kitchen to elevate your living space. Additional desirable features: one off-street parking space (driveway), laundry on site & a fully fenced in yard! Conveniently located just 0.8 miles from the Metro North Train and 1 mile from Veterans Park/Marina, with lively downtown SoNo and Norwalk Harbor a few blocks away, you'll have easy access to various local amenities. This apartment showcases quality craftsmanship and thoughtful enhancements to create a comfortable and elegant living environment. Welcome Home!
